mapper.sql: USER_ID AS userId, LOGIN_ID AS loginId, PASSWORD_HASH AS passwordHash, NICKNAME AS nickname, NAME_ENC AS nameEnc, PHONE_ENC AS phoneEnc, PHONE_HMAC AS phoneHmac, EMAIL_ENC AS emailEnc, EMAIL_HMAC AS emailHmac, BIRTH_YEAR AS birthYear, WORKER_TYPE_CODE AS workerTypeCode, ROLE_CODE AS roleCode, ACCOUNT_STATUS_CODE AS accountStatusCode, LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT AS loginFailCount, PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED_YN AS passwordChangeRequiredYn, LAST_LOGIN_AT AS lastLoginAt, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt, LAST_LOGIN_FAIL_AT AS lastLoginFailAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM APP_USER WHERE PHONE_HMAC = #{phoneHmac} AND ROLE_CODE = 'ROLE_USER' AND ACCOUNT_STATUS_CODE <> 'WITHDRAWN' ORDER BY USER_ID
SELECT FROM APP_USER WHERE EMAIL_HMAC = #{emailHmac} AND ROLE_CODE = 'ROLE_USER' AND ACCOUNT_STATUS_CODE <> 'WITHDRAWN'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM APP_USER WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM APP_USER WHERE EMAIL_HMAC = #{emailHmac}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM APP_USER WHERE NICKNAME = #{nickname}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ASSESSMENT WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND GRADE_STATUS_CODE = 'SCORED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ASSESSMENT WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT USER_ID FROM APP_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE APP_USER SET ACCOUNT_STATUS_CODE = 'WITHDRAWN', WITHDRAWN_AT = #{now}, LOGIN_ID = 'wd_' || TO_CHAR(USER_ID), NICKNAME = '탈퇴' || TO_CHAR(USER_ID), NAME_ENC = 'WITHDRAWN', EMAIL_ENC = 'WITHDRAWN', EMAIL_HMAC = 'WITHDRAWN:' || TO_CHAR(USER_ID), PHONE_ENC = NULL, PHONE_HMAC = NULL, PASSWORD_HASH = NULL, UPDATED_AT = #{now} WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND ACCOUNT_STATUS_CODE <> 'WITHDRAWN'
